spans.s:
(ई) चिती r. 1st cl. (चेतति) चित r. 10th cl. (चेतयति-ते) also (इ) चिति r. 10th cl. (चिन्तयनि)
To think or reflect on, to be sensible or rational, to weigh, to remember, to consider, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Covered, veiled, concealed.
2 Collected, accumulated.
3 Piled, heaped.
f. (-ता)
1 A funeral pile.
2 A heap, an assemblage.
E.
चि to collect, &c. affix क्त; also चिति and चिती.

n. (-त्तं)
The mind or faculty of reasoning, the heart considered as the seat of intellect.
E.
चित to consider, and क्त aff.

f. (चित्)
Intellect, understanding.
ind.
A particle and affix to words giving them an indefinite signification, as कश्चित् some one, कस्यचित् of some one, &c. see चन.
E.
चित् to remember, affix क्विप्.

m. (-ग्निः)
The funeral fire.
E.
चिता the pile, and अग्नि fire.

n. (-कं)
A mark where a funeral pile has been, a mausoleum, a monument, &c.
E.
चिता a pile, and चूडक a crest.

f. (तिः)
Collecting, gathering.
(-तिः-ती)
1 A funeral pile.
2 A heap, a quantity.
3 A pile, a stack.
4 An oblong with quadrangular sides.
E.
चि to collect, affix क्तिन्, and optionally ङीष् is added.

f. (-का)
A small chain worn as an ornament round the loins.
E.
चित to think of, इकन् affix, and fem. form.

m. (-रः)
A cry, a scream.
E.
चित् imitative sound, and कार making.

m. (-ब्दः)
A cry, a scream.
E.
चित्कार the same, and शब्द sound.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Anticipated, expected, calculated.
2 Known.
E.
चित्त, and कलित computed.

m. (-न्मा)
Love.
E.
चित्त, and जन्मन् birth.

f. (-त्तिः)
Contentment, happiness.
E.
चित्त, and निर्वृत्ति repose.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Tranquil, content.
E.
चित्त, and प्रशम calmness.

f. (-ता)
Happiness, gaiety, joy.
E.
चित्त the heart, प्रसन्नता happiness.

mn. (-गः-गं)
Passion, desire.
E.
चित्त, and राग passion.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Kind-hearted, amiable.
E.
चित्त, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-रः)
Change of thoughts or feelings.
E.
चित्त, and विकार alteration.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Changing a person's character or feeling.
E.
चित्त, and विकारिन् causing change.

m. (-वः)
Madness, insanity.
E.
चित्त the mind, and विप्लव affliction.

m. (-मः)
Madness, derangement.
E.
चित्त as above, and विभ्रम wandering.

f. (-त्तिः)
Inward purpose, feeling, emotion.
E.
चित्त, and वृत्ति being.

f. (-ना)
Anxiety, affliction.
E.
चित्त, and वेदना pain.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Felt, perceived, being in the thoughts.
E.
चित्त, and भव being.

m. (-भूः)
Love.
E.
चित्त, and भू born.

m. (-दः)
Inconsistency, contrariety of purpose or will.
E.
चित्त, and भेद difference.

mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्या-ङ्ख्यं)
Pervading the heart, penetrating, knowing the thoughts.
E.
चित्त, and सङ्ख्य what enumerates.

f. (-तिः)
Pride, arrogance, hauteur, haughtiness.
E.
चित्त the mind, समुन्नति elevation.

f. (-तिः)
A multitude of thoughts, minds or emotions.
E.
चित्त, and संहति assemblage.

mfn. (-हृत्)
Winning, fascinating.
E.
चित्त, and हृत् who takes.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Beautiful, agreeable, fascinating.
E.
चित्त, and हारिन् what seizes.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Captivating, attractive.
E.
चित्त, and अपहारिन् what takes away.

m. (-गः)
Consciousness of pleasure or pain, the attention of the mind to its own sensations.
E.
चित्त the mind, and आभोग enjoyment.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Love, attachment, affection.
E.
चित्त, and आसङ्ग devotion.

n. (-क्यं)
Harmony, agreement, unanimity.
E.
चित्त, and ऐक्य identity.

f. (-तिः)
Pride, &c. see चित्तसमुन्नति.
E.
चित्त, and उन्नति elevation.

n. (-त्यं)
A monument, or any mark of the site of a funeral pile.
E.
चिता a pile, and क्यप् affix.
f. (-त्या)
A funeral pile.
m. (-त्यः)
Fire.
E.
चि to collect, ण्यत् affix, and deriv. irr.

n. (-णं)
Burning with a husband's corpse.
E.
चित्या and अधिरोहण ascending.

n. (-णं)
Ascending the funeral pile.
E.
चिति, and आरोहण mounting; also चितारोहण.

r. 10th cl. (चित्रयति)
1 To paint, to delineate, to colour with various colours, &c.
2 To wonder.
3 To cause wonder or be wonderful.
4 To see a rare or wonderful sight.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
1 Variegated, spotted, speckled.
2 Wonderful, surprising.
m. (-त्रः)
A name of YAMA.
f. (-त्रा)
1 A plant: see मूषिकपर्णी.
2 A kind of cucumber: see गोडुम्वा.
3 A plant, commonly Danti: see दन्तिका.
4 A name of SUBHADRĀ, the sister of

JAGANNĀTHA.
5

A star in the virgin's spike.
6 A kind of snake.
7 The name of a river.
8 Illusion, worldly unreality.
9 The name of a nymph of

Svarga.
10

A form of metre.
n. (-त्रं)
1 Wonder, surprise.
2 Painting, delineation, writing, &c.
3 Sky, heaven.
4 A circular ornament, a sectarial mark on the forehead.
5 White or spotted leprosy.
6 Facetious conversation, conundrums, riddles, &c.
7 Writing or arrangement of verses in mathematical or other fanciful figures.
mn. (-त्रः-त्रं)
Variegated colour.
E.
चि to accumulate, Uṇādi affix क्ति, or चित् the mind, and त्र what preserves, from त्रै with क affix, and the duplicate त rejected.

m. (-कः)
1 The Cīta or small hunting leopard.
2 A painter.
3 The castor oil plant.
4 A medicinal plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
n. (-कं)
1 A mark made with Sandal, &c. on the forehead.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-ण्ठः)
A pigeon.
E.
चित्र variegated, speckled, and कण्ठ throat.

m. (-रः)
A painter.
E.
चित्र colouring, and कर who makes.

m. (-रः)
A painter.
E.
चित्र, and कार who makes.

m. (-लः)
A painted cloth used as an elephant's housings, &c.
E.
चित्र, and कम्बल a blanket.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
1 Astonishing, surprising, working [] wonders.
2 Painting, variegating.
m. (-र्म्मा)
1 A magician.
2 A painter.
3 A tree, (Dalbergia ougeiniensis.)
n. (-र्म्म)
Painting, or a painting.
2 Magic.
E.
चित्र surprising, and कर्म्मन् function.

m. (-विद्)
1 A painter.
2 A magician.
E.
चित्रकर्म्म, and विद् who knows.

m. (-यः)
1 A tiger.
2 A Chita.
E.
चित्र speckled, and काय body.

m. (-टः)
The name of a mountain in Bundelkhand, the modern Compteh, and first habitation of RĀMA in his exile.
E.
चित्र wonderful, and कूट peak; it is an epithet of many hills.

m. (-कृत्)
1 A painter.
2 A tree, (Dalbergia ougieniensis.)
E.
चित्र, and कृत् what makes.

m. (-लः)
A kind of lizard.
E.
चित्र speckled, and क्रोड haunch, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Painted, delineated, represented in a picture.
2 Coloured, variegated.
E.
चित्र, and गत gone.

n. (-न्धं)
Yellow orpiment.
E.
चित्र, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-प्तः)
1 A name of YAMA, or rather one of the fourteen

YAMAS.
2

YAMA'S registrar, who records the vices and virtues of mankind.
E.
चित्र wonderful, and गुप्त preserving; or चित्र writing, and गुप्त as before.

mfn. (-गौः-गौः-गु)
Having a brindled cow.
E.
चित्र, and गो a cow.

m. (-ल्पः)
Talking incoherently.
E.
चित्र, and जल्प prattle.

mfn. subst. (-लः-ला-लं)
A medicinal plant, said to possess anthelmintic virtues: see विडङ्ग.
E.
चित्र wonderful, and तण्डुल grain.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Painted or variegated on the surface, (as a floor, &c.)
E.
चित्र, and तल below.

m. (-त्वक्)
The birch or Bhurja tree.
E.
चित्र, and त्वच् bark.

m. (-कः)
The cotton plant.
E.
चित्र, and दण्डक stem.

f. (-त्रा)
A small bird, the Maina of the dialects.
E.
चित्र variegated, and नेत्र an eye.

m. (-क्षः)
The francoline partridge.
E.
चित्र surprising, and पक्ष a wing.

f. (-का)
The name of a plant, commonly कपित्थानी.
E.
चित्र wonderful, and पत्र a leaf.

adv. ind. or n. (-मं)
At a good pace.
E.
चित्र, पद a step, and क्रम going.

f. (-दा)
1 A creeper, (Cissus pedata.)
2 A kind of metre.
E.
चित्र surprising, and पद foot.

f. (-दा)
The Maina, a small bird so called.
E.
चित्र speckled, and पाद foot.

f. (-का)
1 A plant, commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia.)
2 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.)
E.
कन् added to चित्रपर्णी.

Cākuliya.
2

Madder; also चित्रपर्णिका.
E.
चित्र writing or painting, and पर्ण leaf; the leaves being as it were painted: see the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A peacock.
E.
चित्र, and पिच्छ the tail.

m. (-ङ्खः)
An arrow.
E.
चित्र wonderful, and पुङ्ख shaft.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A sparrow.
E.
चित्र speckled, and पृष्ठ the back.

mf. (-लः-ला)
A kind of cucumber, (C. utilatissimus.)
m. (-लः)
A kind of fish, (Mystus chitala, HAM.)
f. (-ला-ली)
1 Egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
2 Prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.)
3 Gourds of various sorts.
4 A fish, (Mystus karpirat, HAM.)
E.
चित्र surprising, and फल fruit.

m. (-कः)
A sort of fish: see the last.
E.
चित्र variegated, and फलक a scale.

Fire.
2

The sun.
3 A name of BHAIRAVA, a form of Ś

IVA.
4

The marking-nut plant.
5 Gigantic swallow wort.
E.
चित्र surprising, and भानु light.

m. (-गः)
The spotted antelope.
E.
चित्र, and मृग a deer.

m. (-लः)
A peacock.
E.
चित्र spotted, and मेखला a girdle.

m. (-धी)
1 A name of

ARJUNA.
2

A tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.)
4 Any hero.
E.
चित्र, and योधिन् a warrior.

m. (-थः)
1 The sun.
2 The chief of the Gandharbas or choristers of INDRA'S heaven.
E.
चित्र painted, and रथ a car; lord of the painted car.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Variegated or spotted.
m. (-लः)
A variegated colour.
E.
चित्र painting, and ल what produces.

f. (-खा)
1 A portrait, a picture.
2 An Apsaras and friend of

UṢĀ.
3
A form of metre.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Represented, delineated, (as in a picture.)
E.
चित्र, and लिखित drawn.

f. (-ना)
The Maina, a small bird so called.
E.
चित्र variegated, and लोचन an eye.

m. (-लः)
A sheat fish, (Silurus pelorius.)
E.
वित्र variegated, and वदाल a sheat fish, the epithet being a pleonasm.

m. (-कः)
A sheat fish.

f. (-त्तिः)
Astonishing act or effort.
E.
चित्र, and वृत्ति practice.

m. (-जः)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
चित्रशिखण्डी one of the seven Ṛṣis, and ज born; being the son of AṄGIRAS; also similar compounds, as चित्रशिखण्डिप्रसुत, &c.

m. plu. (-ण्डिनः)
The seven sages or Ṛṣis, but especially as represented in the seven principal stars of the great bear; these sages are MARĪCI, ATRI, AṄGIRAS, PULAHA, PULASTYA, KRATU, and VASIṢṬHA.
E.
चित्र surprising, शिखण्ड a crest, and इनि affix; sing. nom. case, शिखण्डिन् (-ण्डी).

m. (-तः)
VṚHASPATI.
E.
चित्रशिखण्डि, and प्रसुत born: see चित्रशिखण्डिज; there are other similar compounds.

f. (-श्रीः)
Great beauty, or the loveliness of variegated colours.
E.
चित्र, and श्री beauty.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Pictured, painted.
E.
चित्र, and संस्थ fixed.

m. (-र्पः)
A large speckled snake.
E.
चित्र, and सर्प a snake.

m. (-नः)
One of the judges or recorders of hell.
E.
चित्र, and सेना an army.

f. (-क्षी)
The Maina, (Turdus salica.)
E.
चित्र variegated, अक्ष an eye, fem. affix ङीष्, implying diminution.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Painted, spotted, striped, (the body.)
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A kind of snake.
2 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Yellow orpiment.
2 Vermilion.
f. (-ङ्गी)
1

Madder.
2

A [] worm, (Julus cornifex.)
E.
चित्र spotted or painted, &c. अङ्ग the body.

m. (-दः)
1 A king, the predecessor of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA and PĀṆḌU, and son of Ś

ANTANU.
2

A judge and recorder in hell.
E.
चित्र, अङ्ग body, and द who gives.

f. (-सूः)
The mother of VYĀSA.
E.
चित्राङ्गद the name of a king, uterine brother of VYĀSA, and सू mother.

m. (-रः)
1 The moon.
2 The forehead spotted with the blood of a goat, slain in the worship of the demon GHAṆṬĀKARṆA.
E.
चित्र spotted, &c. and अट to go or be, and ईरन् aff.

n. (-न्नं)
Rice dressed with coloured condiments.
E.
चित्र, and अन्न food.

m. (-पः)
A cake.
E.
चित्र speckled, and आपूप a cake, a plum-cake.

n. (-मं)
Steel.
E.
चित्र, and अयस् iron.

m. (-कः)
The month Chaitra or Cheyt, (March-April.)
E.
चित्र the star, and ठन् affix; also ऐत्रिक.

Painted.
2

Spotted, striped.
3 Variegated.
E.
चित्र to paint, क्त aff.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
1

Variegated.
2

Wonderful.
f. (-णी)
One of the four kinds in which women are classed.
E.
वित्र, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Astonishing, surprising, causing wonder or astonishment.
E.
चित्र with क्यच्, or used as a verb, शानच् aff.

m. (-शः)
The moon.
E.
चित्र the star, and ईंश lord.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 A voice from heaven, that of an invisible speaker.
2 A marvellous tale.
3 Agreeable or eloquent discourse.
E.
चि miraculous, and उक्ति saying.

n. (-नं)
Boiled rice coloured with turmeric, &c.
E.
चित्र variegated, and ओदन boiled rice.
